topic.label: Addition and Subtraction of Rational Expressions

reference.question: Calculate \(\frac{1}{x-1}-\frac{1}{x+1}\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Use a common denominator

Use a common denominator: \(\frac{(x+1)-(x-1)}{(x-1)(x+1)}=\frac{2}{x^2-1}\).
